role_in_op: Supporting site (squad) in op 5. The beacon keepers' fishing hamlet on Lantern Rock; its quay is the only boat landing, so it is how players reach the Lantern Rock Beacon (5-M4) 460 m north-east. The garrison is a small picket in the quay front and the houses round the little square.
approaches_text: Only by boat or air (Lantern Rock is 2.3 km off Acropolis Isle). Boats land at the quay; the main street climbs from it to the square and on to the beacon path.
